text:
maya: Heads-up — customer 'Acme' says their invoice doesn't match our usage export. Invoice shows 31,984,512 embed units for 2026-03-12..18 but the CSV has ~22M rows. can someone check reconciliation?
jon: on it. first thought: retries might be double-counted in ledger but missing from export. are retries considered billable?
alex: policy: successful retry attempts that complete are billed. failed short-circuits are not.
jon: query looks like ~9.8M ledger rows for acme in that window with no corresponding s3 export entry. many rows have X-Retry-Count>0.
chandra: Acme confirmed they had a burst and retried after 429s. they expect dedupe.
maya: customer-facing approach: prefer backfill of export then regenerate invoice rather than manual credit.
jon: hypothesis: embeds-export-v2 dropped streaming-written rows under high concurrency. will upload sample missing request_ids to s3: s3://redwood-debug/finance/acme/missing-1799956780/sample.csv
ops-bot: Job embed-export-v2 finished 2026-03-19T02:12:14Z; processed 120M rows; errors: 12
alex: can run a backfill that reads ledger_events for that client+window and outputs same CSV format. we'll run on a dedicated pool to avoid interfering with nightly exports.
jon: plan: (1) alex run backfill job backfill-1799956780 write to s3://billing-backfills/acme/2026-03-12_18/; (2) validate counts and checksums vs ledger; (3) dry-run invoice regen; (4) finalize invoice if reconciled.
alex: backfill queued. command: python tools/backfill_exports.py --client acme-corp --from 2026-03-12 --to 2026-03-18 --out s3://billing-backfills/acme/2026-03-12_18/ --job-id backfill-1799956780
ops-bot: backfill-1799956780 started at 2026-03-19T03:02:10Z on pool billing-backfills-dedicated
jon: after partial run we're seeing many of the missing request_ids present. if full counts match ledger we proceed to regen invoice.
maya: please also add a short note to the finance audit trail: cause=exports pipeline race resulting in streaming rows not materialized to parquet. tag eng-runtime for postmortem.
alex: fix in PR #4321 changes flush/ack ordering in streaming sink and retries parquet writes. canary deploy planned.
jon: final: backfill produced 9,820,001 rows; ledger shows same; invoice dry-run matches. proceeding to regenerate final invoice.
maya: chandra, prep customer messaging: what happened, what we did, timeline, offer CSV.
chandra: message sent. they asked if retries will be billable going forward.
maya: confirm policy in docs: successful retries are billable. add note to invoice help text.
ops-bot: deploy deploy-2026-03-19-canary completed for env=canary at 2026-03-19T09:12:03Z
maya: loop closed — Acme confirmed receipt and accepts final numbers. filing short incident to finance/incidents.
jon: resolved. :white_check_mark:
